Hi

My name is Saethor and I ordered a KBOX on the 24th of September that was
supposed to ship on the 30th of September. 12 days later and 2x
conversations with your chatbot and it seems the order still isn't shipped.
First, I was told it was an issue because of the shipping location (Iceland)
and the second time I was told it was out of stock.  Order: Shop····.
Can you please give me an update on this. If the issue truly is shipping, I
can arrange for a pickup (DHL).

Last Friday I ordered the new BS-4 which is supposed to ship at the end of
the month. I just want to makes sure the same doesn't happen with that
order, shipping delays due to shipping location. Shop····

Thanks

Saethor A.
Note to the team: I'll pull both orders up before I answer.
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page
Handed to the team · No confirmed ship date for the KBOX; only the manufacturer can give it.

Hi Saethor,

Thanks for laying it out so clearly, and I'm sorry you have had to ask three times.

First, the important correction: Iceland is not the problem, and neither order is held up by your delivery address. You do not need to arrange a DHL pickup. The K. is not shipped from our own warehouse at all, it comes directly from GekkoScience in the US, so what you were told about a shipping location issue and about warehouse stock was not right.

Where Shop···· actually stands: it is paid, nothing has left yet, and the September 30 date you were given at checkout has passed. I do not have a new ship date I can stand behind, so I am not going to invent one. I have put this in front of Georges and Abel to get the real date from GekkoScience. They are offline right now and pick it up today at 10am ET, and the answer comes to you by email in this thread, so you do not need to chase it again.

On Shop····, the Bitfortun BS-4 ships October 31 and nothing about Iceland affects it. It is a separate order and a separate supplier, so the KBOX delay does not carry over to it.

Your $50 code from last week, HD-••••••, is still yours to use.

Sorry again for the back and forth on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
